MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked every MAVROS endpoint, type and message field, all 23 facts, the operator_required setpoint limits and the stop against offb_node.cpp, drone_offboard.cpp, offb_velocity_node.cpp and both launch files at the pin. The e-stop and the safe_state=True action were the /mavros/cmd/land CommandTOL request, whose success only acknowledges a LAND request (drone_offboard.cpp:57-71) after which the clone just sleeps and shuts down (offb_velocity_node.cpp:59-70), and the shipped offb.launch starts offb_node, which requests OFFBOARD and arming again every 5 s while streaming its hover setpoint (offb_node.cpp:53-84), so a LAND is not a stop and could be undone, yet the SDK reported the e-stop completed. The reviewer removed the binding and safe_state=True (/mavros/cmd/land stays an ordinary command), rewrote safe_state, the docstring (which told operators to run offb.launch or offb_velocity.launch), the stop gaps and the velocity input descriptions (the clone logs vz 2 as 'Go Up' and vy -2 as 'Move towards South'), corrected eight facts (ranges that missed the 20 Hz rate, the pose defaults and the altitude wait; 'ignores force' where the mask sets the FORCE flag; the land home_set_ precondition) and added five (driver.py); replaced the latched-stop case with one expecting MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, no upstream call and the latch refusing land, OFFBOARD and setpoints, added a declaration check, and replaced fake-only landed_state assertions with the sent request (test_driver.py); updated facts.md; and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate now fails G6.ESTOP_FAILED and G8 SAFE-028 (no stop at R2), the 12 package cases pass, and collect.py reports RESULT_UNTRUSTED until the orchestrator writes status blocked; the author's notes above still describe /mavros/cmd/land as the e-stop. For the human reviewer: PX4 SITL through MAVROS, both outside the clone; MAVROS can equally be pointed at a serial PX4, so the same surface would fly a real multirotor. An MHS e-stop now calls nothing upstream and, while latched, refuses /mavros/cmd/land too. Do not run the clone's offb.launch or offb_velocity.launch next to this driver: offb_node streams a (0, 0, 2) hover setpoint at 20 Hz with an all-zero quaternion and requests OFFBOARD and arming again every 5 s, which would undo a LAND, and the velocity node flies its own arm, takeoff, velocity and land sequence. Each MHS setpoint is a single publication while the clone states OFFBOARD needs a stream faster than 2 Hz (offb_node.cpp:32). Velocity inputs use the clone's ROS-side signs (vz positive is up). Unblocking needs a stop with a sensed outcome, for example LAND followed by a confirmed landed and disarmed state.
